Whether you’re into team sports, fitness classes or individual training, this club encourages physical well-being and community engagement. Join us to build strength, improve balance and prioritise your health in a fun, supportive environment. Ms. Teja K R Convener Mentorship Assistance Cell (MAC) Ms. Vidya U Jambagi Coordinator Ms. Ume Salma Convener Mr. Jagadish A Convener Ms. Malasa M R Convener The Mentorship Assistance Cell (MAC) provides personalised guidance to students for academic and career development. Through one-on-one mentoring, workshops and networking, students receive valuable insights to achieve their goals and enhance personal and professional growth. UHV Cell (Universal Human Values) Explore life’s deeper meaning with the UHV Cell. We foster understanding, harmony and ethical living. Engage in discussions, workshops and activities promoting universal human values. Join us to cultivate a more conscious and compassionate community. Yoga and Fitness Centre Find inner peace and physical well-being at our Yoga and Fitness Centre. De-stress, improve focus and cultivate mindfulness through yoga and meditation sessions. All levels are welcome. Join us for a serene and transformative experience.
